title: Horrible - Do Not Buy!
text: Horrible - Do Not Buy!. These seemed like a good deal reading about them, but when I opened them up to assemble - boy was I wrong!  I ordered the red and the green balls and the green are about 3-inches, but the red ones were maybe 2-1/2-inches at best - much smaller than the green.  The quality is terrible and these are worth about 10 cents each not the 50 cents they're being sold for.  Nearly half of them tore before I could assemble them and the adhesive only held for a day.  Look elsewhere - these are junk!
